name: DPS Lost & Found
details: University Park Campus: 3667 McClintock Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Students report a lost item by calling or emailing, and drop found items off at that address. Found items are kept for 90 days from the date DPS receives them.

name: Facilities Management Services (FMS)
contactMethod: Online service request, or the FMS Customer Resource Center at (213) 740-6833 for urgent problems on the University Park Campus
details: Handles day-to-day operation, repair and maintenance of USC buildings, infrastructure and grounds. Non-urgent requests go through the online service request form linked from the FPM FAQ (https://fpm.usc.edu/faq/), which points to https://usc.assetworks.cloud/ready. Urgent facilities problems go to the Customer Resource Center by phone. Troy's link into this system is mocked for the demo.

name: USC Housing maintenance
contactMethod: Work Orders link on housing.usc.edu, or the USC Housing Services Office at (800) 872-4632 or housing@usc.edu
details: Residents submit maintenance problems in USC Housing buildings through the Work Orders link on the USC Housing home page (https://hsmtma.usc.edu:444/home.html). Troy's link into this system is mocked for the demo.
